Product description

Stunning 144 Hz, 3D Curved pOLED Display with IP68 Protection Experience the 144 Hz, 3D curved pOLED display with the advanced display color boost technology. The moto g96 5G, featuring the impressive 3D Curved Display. This engineering marvel boasts a 144Hz pOLED screen protected by ultra-durable IP68 underwater protection, accompanied by the most advanced water touch technology, and also has ultra-reliable Corning Gorilla Glass 5. The elegantly curved display provides an immersive viewing experience with its 1600nits brightness and Indulge in captivating entertainment on a 16.67 cm pOLED FHD+ ultra vivid display that has deeper blacks, bringing images to life with life-like clarity. The cinematic Billion Colour 10-Bit Display with 100% DCI-P3 works its magic to bring every moment to life, and SGS eye protection gives added protection to your eyes. Most Advanced Brilliant 50MP OIS Sony - LYTIA 700C Camera with moto AI All Eyes On You' only with the moto g96 5G's segment's best and most advanced 50MP OIS Sony-LYTIA 700C sensor paired with advanced moto ai features like 'AI Photo Enhancement', 'Horizon Lock', and Digital Zoom to elevate your professional photography experience and make every shot memorable. Additionally, enjoy the Segment's only phone with '4K video recording' from all lenses. With its 3-in-1 8MP secondary cameras for wide angle, macro, and depth sensors supporting 4K video recording for the first time in the 32MP Selfie camera with 4K Video recording makes the photography and videography experience even more incredible. Enjoy consistent clarity with the advanced camera system that's equipped with Optical Image Stabilisation (OIS) for capturing clear images and videos while in motion. Capture every moment clearly, be it daylight or night light. Powerful Performance with Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 processor Experience the next-level multi-tasking, gaming, and 5G performance, with the Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 chipset. This cutting-edge processor delivers exceptional performance, efficiency, and 5G connectivity, setting a new benchmark for speed and multitasking in the segment. A modern build with superior 4nm tech that will deliver proven performance for day-to-day activities and unlock amazing experiences like better photos, intensive gaming, the advantage of advanced photography, and power efficiency. Ultra-Premium Design with Vegan Leather Finish Embrace elegance in 4 ultra-premium Pantone curated vegan leather designs with 4 different vegan leather finishes for the first time in any g-series smartphone. Style with the colourful & harmonious design of moto g96 5G. Introduced with a 3D curved design and with ultra-premium finishes, and a light, ultra-thin frame, it’s extremely comfortable and satisfying to hold. Experience the luxurious vegan leather finish for a soft, tactile feel with an added touch of luxury. Paired with an ultra-lightweight build of just 178g and a super slim profile at 7.93mm, this device redefines premium comfort even with the massive 5500mAh battery inside. Ultra-durable IP68 and Gorilla Glass 5 Protection Experience the incredible underwater protection with IP68 Protection, accompanied by Water Touch 2.0 technology that allows you to seamlessly use your phone even with wet hands or splashes. Also be extra worry-free with power-packed Corning Gorilla Glass 5, offering superior scratch and impact resistance, while ThinkShield 3.0 Protection for mobiles delivers enterprise-level security, keeping your data safe from threats. In-built 8 GB RAM + 256 GB Storage Unlock the full potential of your smartphone with an unbeatable combination of speed and storage space. Featuring built-in 8 GB of RAM, seamlessly switches between apps and tasks with unprecedented ease. You can make it even faster with up to 24 GB of RAM using the RAM Boost 2.0 Plus, with a generous 256 GB of internal storage and expandable options, you'll have all the room you need for your apps, media, and files. Capture and keep memories with virtually limitless capacity. Effortless Cross Device Control with Smart Connect 2.0 Sharing and searching across devices has been easier with the Smart Connect 2.0, a Motorola flagship feature. Now search anything across devices using the latest 'cross-device search' option. All it takes is a simple swipe to send photos, videos, and files to nearby devices. It’s quick, intuitive, and seamlessly integrates into your daily life, keeping you connected with friends and family. Play your favourite mobile games, shop, or order anything on your big screen TV/Desktop. Use your apps on a desktop display, giving you more space to work and play, or move your video calls to a big screen TV, it feels like you’re right in the same room with your moto g96 5G. Dolby Atmos Dual Stereo Speakers paired with Hi-Res Sound Immerse yourself in a world of sound with dual stereo speakers enhanced by Dolby Atmos. Experience audio with breathtaking clarity, depth, and power that transforms your media into a truly cinematic experience. Listen to professional-level audio thanks to the hi-res sound certified sound system, and along with moto spatial sound system, you get wider dynamic range and 3x more data rate, you won’t miss any details. Massive 5500 mAh Battery and 33 W Charging The Improved 5500 mAh capacity ensures your device keeps up with your busy lifestyle, providing up to 42 Hours of battery life that keeps you running for longer. When you need a boost, the 33W TurboPower charging rapidly refills your battery, delivering hours of usage in just minutes. It's the perfect combination for those who demand both endurance and speed. Unbelievable 5G Speeds - 13 5G Bands Do more than you ever thought possible with the unbelievable speed of 5G. Download your favourite shows in seconds. Stream with virtually no buffering, all thanks to 13 5G bands with VoNR support for improved voice and video call quality. Advanced 4X4 MIMO technology enhances signal reliability and speed, while dual carrier aggregation maximizes bandwidth to deliver lightning-fast data rates, ensuring you stay connected at the highest speeds available. Latest Android 15 The moto g96 5G is elevated with the latest Android 15, bringing you the latest advancements in mobile technology. Enjoy enhanced privacy controls, seamless multitasking, and a suite of new features designed to make your device more personal and efficient than ever Delightful Software Experiences Enjoy a suite of software features designed for convenience and security. Moto Secure 3.0 keeps your device safe with robust privacy controls, while Family Space 3.0 offers a dedicated environment for family members to explore safely. Moto Unplugged keeps you away from excessive social usage. The moto g96 5G is here to provide you with delightful and unique software experiences.
